openings.claim: A manifest-ordered digest-boundary ledger can locate supported divergence while preserving missing/incomparable-evidence intervals. Script a table joining identifiers, stages, input/output digests and availability; compare corresponding recorded boundaries. A definite earliest stage requires a supplied-record mismatch and equality at preceding applicable boundaries; otherwise report last established equality through first established mismatch. Separate observations from explanations; blank warnings provide no execution evidence.
openings.discriminator: Against timestamp-sorted review, should avoid moving anomalous export ahead of parse solely by timestamp. Missing transform outputs or removed records should widen uncertainty, never establish skipped execution. These are predictions, not measured improvements. Defeat: unsupported definite claims, intervals excluding injected boundaries, or shared inspection/time-limit overruns.
openings.probe: Freeze both variants on two disjoint three-pair subsets within sixty analysis minutes plus twenty comparison minutes. Script indexing/comparisons; log all manual inspections, maximum twelve per pair shared across variants. Resolve record-linked disagreements within that cap; otherwise freeze intervals. Before final freezing randomly remove one transform record from each of two pairs, retaining unchanged manifests and discrepancies. Only afterward open two sealed answer sheets; compare supported claims, injected-boundary interval containment and inspection counts. Each output needs record references and an available-record digest/identifier next check, or an explicit statement that supplied records cannot check the missing boundary.
openings.uncertainty: Dictionary-based corresponding-boundary identification is assumed; ambiguity preserves intervals. Manifest expected order proves neither actual chronology nor causal linkage. Automation setup and ambiguous boundaries may consume capacity; discrimination is not guaranteed. Missing records never prove nonexecution; answer sheets supply evaluation only after freezing.

lineage.reason: Protected causal relation, rival predictions, probe, declared preserves fit, assumptions and defeat/resource caveats retained.

decision: Probe this bounded workflow for all six synthetic pairs, each with twelve records, using supplied manifest, field dictionary and spreadsheet/local scripts. Report each earliest supported stage or unresolved interval with references and feasible next check; no deployment or guaranteed improvement claim.
